data.text: I’m with Kate and Jack: 10 tons each. I appreciate being offered 12, but I won’t ask another household to take less just so I can take more. My family taught me that this lake is our livelihood, not just this month’s payday. I’ll choose 10 this month, and I propose we review the reported catches together afterward. Luke and Emma, will you both join us? With everyone on board, we can earn $10,000 each month while keeping the lake full.
